# Breaking API changes a human has approved (ADR-0016). The ci `api-breaking-changes` job passes this
# file to `oasdiff breaking --err-ignore`. To approve one, copy the method, path and message from the job
# log onto its own line, e.g.:
#   GET /api/system/info removed the required property `version` from the response with the `200` status
# This file lives under .github/, a protected path (CODEOWNERS): only Lucas approves an entry, and agents
# never add one on their own. Entries can be deleted once the approving PR is merged.
